rca of the issue: ROOT CAUSE: routes/loyalty.py was not in the refactor batch list (it's a 'legacy' loyalty rewards CRUD file, separate from loyalty_engine.py which handles modern earn/redeem). When server.py runs `api_router.include_router(loyalty_router)` (line 63) BEFORE `api_router.include_router(loyalty_engine_router)` (line 80), FastAPI registers loyalty.py's /loyalty/redeem first, and that one has no auth check (just `customer_id: str, reward_id: str` as bare params). REPRODUCTION: `curl -X POST $URL/api/loyalty/redeem?customer_id=X&reward_id=Y` — should return 401 but currently performs the redemption logic (200 if customer/reward exist, 404 otherwise). MITIGATION: delete the legacy redeem function in routes/loyalty.py (lines 30-49) since loyalty_engine.py has a superior, auth-protected implementation. Alternatively add `from deps import get_user` import and `_: dict = Depends(get_user)` to the legacy function.
